nabat-village.text:
Draw 3 more cards in your starting hand. You can't take a mulligan.
When the first action phase starts: Put 3 cards from your hand on the bottom of your deck in any order.
nabat-village.rules: Nabat Village's triggered ability is resolved at the start of the first action phase, after setup but before the player with initiative has taken their first action.
